objective: Auditar exclusivamente la semantica comercial de dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial y dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360 despues de Gate4D. Determinar con evidencia si V2 respeta las reglas canonicas EDARSAHUB para ventas validas y fecha operativa, o si requiere V3. No modificar vistas, tablas, codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: g4e_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: g4e_venta_encabezado_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Encabezado') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_venta_status_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Estatus') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_operational_date_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fecha%oper%' OR LOWER(c.name) IN ('fechaoperacion','fecha_operacion','fecha_operativa')) ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_comercial_canonical_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%comercial%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%kpi%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%venta%valid%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_venta_status_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (100) CAST(Estado AS nvarchar(200)) AS estado,COUNT_BIG(*) AS rows_count,SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cliente_nulls,MIN(FechaVenta) AS min_fecha,MAX(FechaVenta) AS max_fecha FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado GROUP BY CAST(Estado AS nvarchar(200)) ORDER BY rows_count DESC

queries.name: g4e_activity_sample
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (50) * FROM dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial ORDER BY ClienteID

queries.name: g4e_customer360_sample
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (50) * FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360 ORDER BY ClienteID

queries.name: g4e_raw_vs_activity_totals
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado WHERE ClienteID IS NOT NULL) AS raw_rows_with_cliente,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial) AS activity_customer_rows,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360) AS customer360_rows

queries.name: g4e_null_cliente_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_ventas,SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cliente_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cliente_present FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado
